summary:
**Space Mission Design Game – Interactive Space Mission Planning & Simulation**

We developed an interactive Space Mission Design Game that allows users to experience the role of a Space Mission Director. The platform enables players to design and configure spacecraft, select space missions such as Earth Observation, Lunar Reconnaissance, Mars Pathfinder, and Storm Watch, and make critical engineering decisions involving payload mass, power generation, orbital selection, launch vehicles, and budget management.

The game features 3D space visualization, real-time mission configuration, engineering validation, unexpected mission events, and automated mission performance reports. It simulates the challenges of planning and executing space missions by demonstrating how engineering decisions affect mission success.

Our solution addresses the challenge of making complex space mission planning more interactive, accessible, and engaging. It is important because it promotes scientific curiosity, develops problem-solving and decision-making skills, and introduces users to the engineering principles behind real-world space exploration through an educational gaming experience.
details:
Project Details – Space Mission Design Game

Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive space mission planning and simulation platform that allows users to experience the responsibilities of a Space Mission Director. It transforms complex space exploration concepts into an engaging, educational gaming experience.

How Does It Work?

Users can select different space missions, including Earth Observation, Lunar Reconnaissance, Mars Pathfinder, and Storm Watch. They can configure spacecraft parameters such as payload mass, power generation, orbital selection, launch vehicle, and mission budget.

The system evaluates engineering constraints through preflight validation checks. Once the configuration is complete, users can launch a mission simulation, encounter unexpected mission events, make critical decisions, and receive a mission performance report. The 3D space visualization provides a more immersive understanding of spacecraft and planetary environments.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project encourages scientific curiosity and introduces users to the challenges of real-world space exploration. It helps develop problem-solving, critical thinking, resource management, and decision-making skills. It also makes space science more accessible through interactive learning rather than relying only on theoretical explanations.

Tools and Technologies Used

  • Frontend: React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
  • 3D Visualization: Three.js
  • Backend: Node.js, Socket.IO
  • Development Environment: Visual Studio Code
  • Version Control: Git and GitHub

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of our project is the combination of space mission planning, spacecraft configuration, 3D visualization, engineering validation, and interactive mission simulation in one platform. Instead of simply presenting information about space missions, we allow users to make decisions and experience their consequences.

Factors Considered

During development, we considered engineering feasibility, payload limitations, power requirements, orbital compatibility, launch vehicle capacity, mission budgets, unexpected mission risks, and overall mission performance.

Our goal is to create an educational and interactive experience that inspires users to explore space science, understand engineering challenges, and think like real mission planners.
